name: Traxxas 58034-2: Traxxas Slash RTR Short Course Trucks with On-Board Audio
description: Traxxas 58034-2: RC Truck, Slash, Mark Jenkins, Electric, 1/10 Scale, 2WD, On-Board Audio, Battery, Charger, Transmitter, Each - Traxxas Slash RTR Short Course Trucks with Audio allow you to grab the throttle and the On-Board Audio System roars to life, projecting the actual engine sounds from a 900+ horsepower Pro 4X4 short course truck. Prepare to experience the beat of every piston stroke, feel the gear shifts under acceleration, and hear the horsepower as the RPM's scream through the power band. Bash it, crash it, and get it wet. No need to hold back...the sound system is just as rugged as the Slash itself. Flip the rocker switch on the supplied 3-channel TQ 2.4 GHz transmitter to put the truck in neutral to rev up the engine. The precision audio and throttle response connects you to the truck for a whole new driving experience. Traxxas On-Board Audio is the exciting new dimension in Radio Controlled fun! The Traxxas Slash RTR short course trucks will put you in the driver seat for intense fender-to-fender, high-flying, off-road action. These 1/10 scale RC trucks are available in race replica versions with officially licensed paint and graphics.

name: Dynam Waco Yellow 1270mm Wingspan - Pnp
description: The Dynam Waco Bi-Plane offers an appealing combination of performance, style and affordability. Designed using the latest technology in durable EPO foam providing lightweight and structural rigidity, the result is an aircraft that offers awesome levels of performance. This bi-plane spans its wings at 50 inches and sits at an overall length of almost 39 inches. Control surfaces are handled by four 9 gram Detrum servos and it includes a steerable tail wheel for easy taxing around the runway. When more power is needed during sports aerobatic flying, the TomCat power system delivers it effortlessly and smoothly. An easy access hatch allows for quick battery changes without having to remove the wings. The power train and scale like features allow this plane to fly gracefully with outstanding flight characteristics. What are included: Dynam Waco airplane, motor, ESC, 4*9g servos What are required: 6 channel and above transmitter and receive 14.8V 2200mAh 25C battery and charger Dynam 14.8V 2200mAh 25C battery 2 h
